title: Discrete Entropic Gravity on a Cubic Graph: Emergent Newton and MOND Regimes with Λ-Locked Screening
abstract: Constructs a discrete gravity operator on a cubic graph with entropic flux weighting. Numerically recovers Newtonian 1/r² and MOND-like 1/r scaling, Λ-locked regime transitions, broken superposition (13.7% violation), and the external field effect. An emergent prefactor C ≈ 2.32 yields a₀,eff ≈ 5.4 a₀, and mass scaling follows r_trans ∝ M^0.18 (vs MOND M^0.5).

efc_context.regime_relevance: Galactic-scale gravity; Newton-to-MOND transition on discrete graph

key_results: Newton slope recovery: -2.00; MOND slope recovery: -0.99 to -1.01
Emergent prefactor C = 2.32, giving a0_eff = C^2 * a0 ~ 5.4 a0
External field effect confirmed on cubic graph
